description: This file defines the Order entity class for an e-commerce system, including its properties, database mapping annotations, relationships with other entities, and methods to access and modify order data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order in the e-commerce platform, encapsulating order details, status, associated products, billing/shipping info, payment info, and related history.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the order's current status.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Gets the last modification timestamp of the order.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Sets the last modification timestamp of the order.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date of the order.

methods.name: getOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the order was finished.

methods.name: setOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Sets the finish date of the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyValue
methods.description: Gets the currency exchange rate applicable to the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyValue
methods.description: Sets the currency exchange rate for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total monetary value of the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total monetary value of the order.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address from which the order was placed.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address related to the order.

methods.name: getPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Retrieves the payment module code used for transaction processing.

methods.name: setPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the payment module code.

methods.name: getShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping module code.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the shipping module code.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the Currency object associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the Currency object for the order.

methods.name: getMerchant
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with the order.

methods.name: setMerchant
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with the order.

methods.name: getOrderProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of products included in the order.

methods.name: setOrderProducts
methods.description: Sets the products associated with the order.

methods.name: getOrderTotal
methods.description: Returns order total components.

methods.name: setOrderTotal
methods.description: Sets the order total components.

methods.name: getOrderHistory
methods.description: Returns the history of status changes for the order.

methods.name: setOrderHistory
methods.description: Sets the order's status change history.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Associates delivery information with the order.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves the delivery details.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Associates billing information with the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Retrieves billing details.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the channel through which the order was made.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Gets the order channel.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Associates credit card details with the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Retrieves credit card information.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment method type.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the order type (e.g., standard, gift, etc.).

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the order type.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the order.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the order.
